name: Operations — Shift Handover (12 Hours)
description: A 12-hour shift template for operations centres, control rooms, or 24/7 facilities. Covers incoming shift briefing, operational monitoring, scheduled checks, reporting, and handover to the next shift. Use as a repeating pattern for continuous operations.

groups.name: Shift Supervisor
groups.description: Shift leader responsible for all operations during the shift

roles.name: Shift Supervisor
roles.description: Leads shift, makes operational decisions, approves reports

roles.name: Duty Operator
roles.description: Monitors systems, responds to events, maintains logs

events.title: Incoming Shift Handover Brief
events.description: Outgoing shift briefs incoming: open incidents, pending tasks, key contacts, known issues.

events.title: System Status Check
events.description: Verify all monitored systems are operational. Check dashboards and alerts.

events.title: Mid-Morning Check-In
events.description: Quick status check: any new issues, resource needs, or schedule changes.

events.title: Noon Status Report
events.description: Mid-shift status report: events handled, system health, upcoming tasks.

events.title: Afternoon Check-In
events.description: Afternoon status check. Review remaining tasks for the shift.

events.title: End-of-Shift Report
events.description: Compile shift summary: events, decisions, open items, handover notes.

events.title: Outgoing Shift Handover
events.description: Brief incoming shift on everything they need to know. Confirm handover complete.

events.title: Shift Ends
events.description: Outgoing shift personnel released. Incoming shift has full responsibility.
